local_modifications.change: Rebuilt from shaders/ with tool/build_shaders.dart so the lit fragment declares a second color output.
Rebuilt from shaders/ with tool/build_shaders.dart so the unlit fragment writes encoded view depth to a second color output.
Let a render pass hold the frustum so it is computed once per pass instead of once per culled component.

Add a render resolution scale and clamp the render size to [0.25, 1] of the viewport. Present a post-processed image larger than the render size, such as an upscaled one, through its full extent. Hold the camera frustum for the duration of the scene pass so each culled component reuses it.
Walk the six frustum planes without allocating a list per cull test.
Expose the render resolution scale used by World3D.

Create an optional second RGBA8 color attachment, blended by source alpha, alongside the main color target; build instanced pipelines from an explicit two-buffer vertex layout and draw instances from host-buffer instance data.
Accept an optional secondary color clear value when creating render targets; declare optional instanced pipelines, their vertex/instance layout and an instanced render pass interface.
Expose the optional secondary color texture of a render target.
Accept the secondary color clear value; WebGPU targets report no secondary attachment.
Bind uniforms from ByteData and pool render targets by size and secondary color clear value; report instancing support for the open pass and bind instanced geometry.
Select a surface without joints through a constant empty list instead of allocating one per draw.
Order the node hierarchy once per model and reuse the processed nodes of a model without a running animation.
Reuse precomputed joint uniform keys instead of interpolating them per draw.
Pack vertex attributes directly into a Float32List without boxed intermediate lists.

Replace the unbounded process-wide Color cache with one reusable four-float Vector4 per Shader; retain exact RGBA Float32 uploads. Replace unbounded RegExpMatch retention with a shared FIFO cache of at most 256 fully parsed uniform keys; preserve grammar, errors and resource-local GPU bindings. Resolve each uniform key once per shader into its binding and offset, and bind a stable ByteData view. Rebind an existing texture slot without allocating a putIfAbsent closure. Bind slots from an insertion-ordered list instead of iterating the binding map on every draw.
Add the internal bounded uniform-key parser cache; retain only successful pure syntax results, with FIFO eviction and no GPU layout or value retention.
Remove workspace resolution so this runtime snapshot resolves as a standalone path dependency.
Add the shared encoder for view depth written to the secondary color attachment.
Declare a second color output that leaves the secondary attachment unchanged.
Write encoded view depth to the second color output.
Pass view-space depth to the fragment stage.
Add a rerunnable impellerc build of the unlit and spatial shader bundles from shaders/.
